childNodes.textContent: Mice in Mouse colony: bring in a spreadsheet
Back to Mice in Mouse colony

Upload the Excel workbook (.xlsx) or CSV you keep your mice in. It can have any columns, in any
        order: the next step matches them to BioManager's, and you can change every match. Nothing is saved until
        you've seen a preview.
.xlsx, .csv or .tsv, up to 15 MB and 5,000 rows
Columns in Mice in Mouse colony
or mouse, id, mouse number, animal id
or ear tag, eartag, tag, ear punch
or gender, m f, male female
or dob, birth date, birthdate, born
or cage number, cage id, cage card
or position, slot, rack position, cage position
or death date, dod, sac date, euthanized

Columns are matched by meaning as well as by name, so “Location”, “Slot” or “Well” holding A1, B2… go to the position, and “DOB” or “Born” to the date of birth.
        The mouse colony's columns are fixed, so any others go into each mouse's notes.
        A must-have column your sheet lacks gets one value for every row.
